answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake and finish a verifiable compute task before it can earn or vote. The stake is a clear signal of commitment: creating thousands of fake identities means locking thousands of stakes, like buying timber for every fake house instead of one shared shed. A crystal clear rule then slashes the stake of any identity caught voting twice or copying work, so a sybil farm pays repeatedly while honest agents pay once and keep their stake.
